examples.hanzi: 现实有时候比想象中更残酷。
examples.pinyin: Xiànshí yǒushíhou bǐ xiǎngxiàng zhōng gèng cánkù.
examples.english: Reality is sometimes crueler than we imagine.

examples.hanzi: 比赛的竞争非常残酷，只有一个人能赢。
examples.pinyin: Bǐsài de jìngzhēng fēicháng cánkù, zhǐ yǒu yí gè rén néng yíng.
examples.english: The competition is brutal, and only one person can win.

examples.hanzi: 这家医院的使命是让每个人都看得起病。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn de shǐmìng shì ràng měi gè rén dōu kàn de qǐ bìng.
examples.english: This hospital's mission is to make care affordable for everyone.

examples.hanzi: 老师觉得教书育人是自己的使命。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī juéde jiàoshū yùrén shì zìjǐ de shǐmìng.
examples.english: The teacher feels that educating people is her calling.

examples.hanzi: 游客们坐大巴返回了酒店。
examples.pinyin: Yóukèmen zuò dàbā fǎnhuí le jiǔdiàn.
examples.english: The tourists took the coach back to the hotel.

examples.hanzi: 点击这个按钮可以返回主页。
examples.pinyin: Diǎnjī zhège ànniǔ kěyǐ fǎnhuí zhǔyè.
examples.english: Click this button to go back to the home page.

examples.hanzi: 我的杯子里装满了热茶。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de bēizi lǐ zhuāngmǎn le rè chá.
examples.english: My cup is full of hot tea.

examples.hanzi: 小心点，别把杯子打碎了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoxīn diǎn, bié bǎ bēizi dǎsuì le.
examples.english: Be careful not to break the glass.

examples.hanzi: 她很害羞，不敢在大家面前唱歌。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn hàixiū, bù gǎn zài dàjiā miànqián chànggē.
examples.english: She is shy and doesn't dare to sing in front of everyone.

examples.hanzi: 别害羞，想吃什么就自己拿。
examples.pinyin: Bié hàixiū, xiǎng chī shénme jiù zìjǐ ná.
examples.english: Don't be shy; help yourself to whatever you like.

examples.hanzi: 这个古老的帝国持续了几百年。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gǔlǎo de dìguó chíxù le jǐ bǎi nián.
examples.english: This ancient empire lasted for several hundred years.

examples.hanzi: 我们在历史课上学到了帝国衰落的原因。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài lìshǐ kè shàng xué dào le dìguó shuāiluò de yuányīn.
examples.english: In history class we learned why empires decline.

examples.hanzi: 在公共场合，请保持安静。
examples.pinyin: Zài gōnggòng chǎnghé, qǐng bǎochí ānjìng.
examples.english: Please keep quiet in public places.

examples.hanzi: 这身衣服不适合参加婚礼那样的场合。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shēn yīfu bú shìhé cānjiā hūnlǐ nàyàng de chǎnghé.
examples.english: This outfit isn't suitable for an occasion like a wedding.

examples.hanzi: 这瓶洗手液含有百分之七十五的酒精。
examples.pinyin: Zhè píng xǐshǒuyè hányǒu bǎi fēn zhī qīshíwǔ de jiǔjīng.
examples.english: This bottle of hand sanitizer contains seventy-five percent alcohol.

examples.hanzi: 对酒精过敏的人不能喝酒。
examples.pinyin: Duì jiǔjīng guòmǐn de rén bù néng hējiǔ.
examples.english: People who are allergic to alcohol can't drink.

examples.hanzi: 星期五下午我们早点下班。
examples.pinyin: Xīngqīwǔ xiàwǔ wǒmen zǎodiǎn xiàbān.
examples.english: On Friday afternoon we get off work early.

examples.hanzi: 今天是星期五，明天就是周末了。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shì xīngqīwǔ, míngtiān jiù shì zhōumò le.
examples.english: Today is Friday, and tomorrow is the weekend.

examples.hanzi: 小区里有一个很大的游泳池。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoqū lǐ yǒu yí gè hěn dà de yóuyǒngchí.
examples.english: There is a big swimming pool in our residential area.

examples.hanzi: 游泳池每天早上六点开门。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyǒngchí měi tiān zǎoshang liù diǎn kāimén.
examples.english: The swimming pool opens at six every morning.

examples.hanzi: 晚上他好像看到了一个白色的幽灵。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnshang tā hǎoxiàng kàndào le yí gè báisè de yōulíng.
examples.english: At night he thought he saw a white ghost.

examples.hanzi: 这个游戏里的幽灵会追着你跑。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yóuxì lǐ de yōulíng huì zhuīzhe nǐ pǎo.
examples.english: The ghosts in this game chase after you.

examples.hanzi: 哥哥喜欢收集汽车模型。
examples.pinyin: Gēge xǐhuan shōují qìchē móxíng.
examples.english: My older brother likes collecting model cars.

examples.hanzi: 科学家建立了一个预测天气的模型。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā jiànlì le yí gè yùcè tiānqì de móxíng.
examples.english: Scientists built a model to predict the weather.

examples.hanzi: 半夜里传来了一阵诡异的笑声。
examples.pinyin: Bànyè lǐ chuánlái le yí zhèn guǐyì de xiàoshēng.
examples.english: A weird laugh came from somewhere in the middle of the night.

examples.hanzi: 房间里的气氛有点诡异。
examples.pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ de qìfēn yǒudiǎn guǐyì.
examples.english: The atmosphere in the room is a little eerie.

examples.hanzi: 他是个直性子，有话就直说。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì gè zhíxìngzi, yǒu huà jiù zhíshuō.
examples.english: He's a straightforward person who says things outright.

examples.hanzi: 不用绕弯子，你直说吧。
examples.pinyin: Búyòng rào wānzi, nǐ zhíshuō ba.
examples.english: No need to beat around the bush; just say it directly.

examples.hanzi: 火车准时到达了北京站。
examples.pinyin: Huǒchē zhǔnshí dàodá le Běijīng zhàn.
examples.english: The train arrived at Beijing station on time.

examples.hanzi: 请大家准时参加明天的活动。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng dàjiā zhǔnshí cānjiā míngtiān de huódòng.
examples.english: Please be punctual for tomorrow's event.

examples.hanzi: 这台电视的画面特别清楚。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái diànshì de huàmiàn tèbié qīngchu.
examples.english: This TV has an especially sharp picture.

examples.hanzi: 孩子们在海边玩耍的画面很温馨。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen zài hǎibiān wánshuǎ de huàmiàn hěn wēnxīn.
examples.english: The scene of children playing by the sea is heartwarming.

examples.hanzi: 部长明天要去外地出差。
examples.pinyin: Bùzhǎng míngtiān yào qù wàidì chūchāi.
examples.english: The minister will go on a business trip to another city tomorrow.

examples.hanzi: 我们部门的新部长很年轻。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bùmén de xīn bùzhǎng hěn niánqīng.
examples.english: The new head of our department is very young.

examples.hanzi: 我想吃牛肉面。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng chī niúròu miàn.
examples.english: I'd like to eat beef noodles.

examples.hanzi: 这块牛肉要炖两个小时才会软。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuài niúròu yào dùn liǎng gè xiǎoshí cái huì ruǎn.
examples.english: This piece of beef needs to be stewed for two hours to get tender.

examples.hanzi: 夜里气温会下降到零下五度。
examples.pinyin: Yèlǐ qìwēn huì xiàjiàng dào língxià wǔ dù.
examples.english: The temperature will fall to minus five at night.

examples.hanzi: 他的成绩最近有点下降。
examples.pinyin: Tā de chéngjì zuìjìn yǒudiǎn xiàjiàng.
examples.english: His grades have dropped a bit recently.

examples.hanzi: 如果看到可疑的人，请马上报警。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ kàndào kěyí de rén, qǐng mǎshàng bàojǐng.
examples.english: If you see a suspicious person, call the police at once.

examples.hanzi: 他的解释听起来很可疑。
examples.pinyin: Tā de jiěshì tīng qǐlái hěn kěyí.
examples.english: His explanation sounds dubious.

examples.hanzi: 小孩被恶梦吓醒了，哭个不停。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎohái bèi èmèng xià xǐng le, kū gè bù tíng.
examples.english: The child woke up from a nightmare and kept crying.

examples.hanzi: 那次车祸成了他一辈子的恶梦。
examples.pinyin: Nà cì chēhuò chéng le tā yíbèizi de èmèng.
examples.english: That car accident became a lifelong nightmare for him.

examples.hanzi: 你可以复制这段文字，再粘贴到文档里。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ fùzhì zhè duàn wénzì, zài zhāntiē dào wéndàng lǐ.
examples.english: You can copy this text and paste it into the document.

examples.hanzi: 这幅画太珍贵了，没办法复制。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fú huà tài zhēnguì le, méi bànfǎ fùzhì.
examples.english: This painting is so precious that it can't be replicated.

examples.hanzi: 吃了药以后，疼痛慢慢减轻了。
examples.pinyin: Chī le yào yǐhòu, téngtòng mànmàn jiǎnqīng le.
examples.english: After taking the medicine, the pain slowly eased.

examples.hanzi: 他的膝盖一阵阵地疼痛。
examples.pinyin: Tā de xīgài yízhènzhèn de téngtòng.
examples.english: His knee aches in waves.

examples.hanzi: 她是一位专业的摄影师，擅长人像摄影。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yí wèi zhuānyè de shèyǐngshī, shàncháng rénxiàng shèyǐng.
examples.english: She is a professional photographer who is good at portrait photography.

examples.hanzi: 这部电影的摄影非常出色。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de shèyǐng fēicháng chūsè.
examples.english: The cinematography of this film is outstanding.

examples.hanzi: 外面又打雷又闪电，快关窗吧。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn yòu dǎléi yòu shǎndiàn, kuài guān chuāng ba.
examples.english: It's thundering and lightning outside; quickly close the window.

examples.hanzi: 他像闪电一样冲了出去。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiàng shǎndiàn yíyàng chōng le chūqù.
examples.english: He dashed out like lightning.

examples.hanzi: 她在课堂上总是积极发言。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài kètáng shàng zǒngshì jījí fāyán.
examples.english: She always speaks up actively in class.

examples.hanzi: 面对困难，我们要保持积极的态度。
examples.pinyin: Miànduì kùnnan, wǒmen yào bǎochí jījí de tàidu.
examples.english: In the face of difficulties, we should keep a positive attitude.

examples.hanzi: 他申请假释，但是没有被批准。
examples.pinyin: Tā shēnqǐng jiǎshì, dànshì méiyǒu bèi pīzhǔn.
examples.english: He applied for parole, but it wasn't approved.

examples.hanzi: 假释期间，他必须定期向警察报到。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎshì qījiān, tā bìxū dìngqī xiàng jǐngchá bàodào.
examples.english: While on parole, he must report to the police regularly.

examples.hanzi: 去英国旅行时，我们顺便参观了巴斯。
examples.pinyin: Qù Yīngguó lǚxíng shí, wǒmen shùnbiàn cānguān le Bāsī.
examples.english: On our trip to England, we visited Bath along the way.

examples.hanzi: 巴斯以古罗马浴场闻名。
examples.pinyin: Bāsī yǐ gǔ Luómǎ yùchǎng wénmíng.
examples.english: Bath is famous for its ancient Roman baths.

examples.hanzi: 银行会评估你的还款能力。
examples.pinyin: Yínháng huì pínggū nǐ de huánkuǎn nénglì.
examples.english: The bank will assess your ability to repay.

examples.hanzi: 这份评估报告明天就能出来。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn pínggū bàogào míngtiān jiù néng chūlái.
examples.english: This assessment report will be ready tomorrow.

examples.hanzi: 台风警报已经解除了。
examples.pinyin: Táifēng jǐngbào yǐjīng jiěchú le.
examples.english: The typhoon warning has been lifted.

examples.hanzi: 公司和他解除了劳动合同。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī hé tā jiěchú le láodòng hétong.
examples.english: The company terminated his employment contract.

examples.hanzi: 我们家的车库可以停两辆车。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jiā de chēkù kěyǐ tíng liǎng liàng chē.
examples.english: Our garage can hold two cars.

examples.hanzi: 爸爸在车库里修自行车。
examples.pinyin: Bàba zài chēkù lǐ xiū zìxíngchē.
examples.english: Dad is fixing a bicycle in the garage.

examples.hanzi: 山里的通讯信号很差。
examples.pinyin: Shān lǐ de tōngxùn xìnhào hěn chà.
examples.english: The communication signal in the mountains is poor.

examples.hanzi: 这篇通讯报道了灾区的最新情况。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piān tōngxùn bàodào le zāiqū de zuìxīn qíngkuàng.
examples.english: This news report covers the latest situation in the disaster area.

examples.hanzi: 早安，今天天气真好！
examples.pinyin: Zǎo'ān, jīntiān tiānqì zhēn hǎo!
examples.english: Good morning, the weather is lovely today!

examples.hanzi: 她每天都会给我发一条早安的消息。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu huì gěi wǒ fā yì tiáo zǎo'ān de xiāoxi.
examples.english: She sends me a good morning message every day.

examples.hanzi: 有人在我身后叫我的名字。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén zài wǒ shēnhòu jiào wǒ de míngzi.
examples.english: Someone behind me called my name.

examples.hanzi: 小狗一直跟在主人身后。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo gǒu yìzhí gēn zài zhǔrén shēnhòu.
examples.english: The little dog keeps following behind its owner.

examples.hanzi: 楼下的早点摊有豆浆和油条。
examples.pinyin: Lóuxià de zǎodiǎn tān yǒu dòujiāng hé yóutiáo.
examples.english: The breakfast stall downstairs sells soy milk and fried dough sticks.

examples.hanzi: 你早点吃了吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zǎodiǎn chī le ma?
examples.english: Have you had breakfast?

examples.hanzi: 吃完饭，我帮妈妈洗盘子。
examples.pinyin: Chī wán fàn, wǒ bāng māma xǐ pánzi.
examples.english: After the meal, I help Mom wash the dishes.

examples.hanzi: 这个盘子是白色的，上面画着小花。
examples.pinyin: Zhège pánzi shì báisè de, shàngmiàn huà zhe xiǎo huā.
examples.english: This plate is white with little flowers painted on it.

examples.hanzi: 别小看他，他厉害着呢。
examples.pinyin: Bié xiǎokàn tā, tā lìhai zhene.
examples.english: Don't underestimate him; he's quite impressive.

examples.hanzi: 离放假还早着呢，再坚持一下。
examples.pinyin: Lí fàngjià hái zǎo zhene, zài jiānchí yíxià.
examples.english: There's still plenty of time before the holiday, so hang in there.

examples.hanzi: 这里的春天如同画一样美。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de chūntiān rútóng huà yíyàng měi.
examples.english: Spring here is as beautiful as a painting.

examples.hanzi: 她对我如同亲妹妹一样。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì wǒ rútóng qīn mèimei yíyàng.
examples.english: She treats me just like a real younger sister.

examples.hanzi: 感谢大家给予我的帮助。
examples.pinyin: Gǎnxiè dàjiā jǐyǔ wǒ de bāngzhù.
examples.english: Thank you all for the help you gave me.

examples.hanzi: 老师给予了他很高的评价。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī jǐyǔ le tā hěn gāo de píngjià.
examples.english: The teacher gave him high praise.

examples.hanzi: 这座大桥建造了整整三年。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò dàqiáo jiànzào le zhěngzhěng sān nián.
examples.english: This big bridge took a full three years to build.

examples.hanzi: 他们打算在海边建造一座小别墅。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen dǎsuàn zài hǎibiān jiànzào yí zuò xiǎo biéshù.
examples.english: They plan to build a small villa by the sea.

examples.hanzi: 他是个典型的北方人，说话很爽快。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì gè diǎnxíng de běifāngrén, shuōhuà hěn shuǎngkuai.
examples.english: He is a typical northerner who speaks very frankly.

examples.hanzi: 这位老师是全校的先进典型。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎoshī shì quánxiào de xiānjìn diǎnxíng.
examples.english: This teacher is a model example for the whole school.

examples.hanzi: 老爷爷呵呵地笑着，摸了摸孩子的头。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo yéye hēhē de xiàozhe, mō le mō háizi de tóu.
examples.english: The old man chuckled and patted the child's head.

examples.hanzi: 他只回了我一个呵呵，我也不知道他什么意思。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhǐ huí le wǒ yí gè hēhē, wǒ yě bù zhīdào tā shénme yìsi.
examples.english: He only replied with a 'haha', and I don't know what he meant.

examples.hanzi: 这家餐馆因为疫情破产了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cānguǎn yīnwèi yìqíng pòchǎn le.
examples.english: This restaurant went bankrupt because of the pandemic.

examples.hanzi: 他担心自己的生意会破产。
examples.pinyin: Tā dānxīn zìjǐ de shēngyi huì pòchǎn.
examples.english: He is worried that his business will go bust.

examples.hanzi: 你可以在手机上查看快递的位置。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ zài shǒujī shàng chákàn kuàidì de wèizhi.
examples.english: You can check the parcel's location on your phone.

examples.hanzi: 医生查看了他的检查结果。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng chákàn le tā de jiǎnchá jiéguǒ.
examples.english: The doctor looked over his test results.

examples.hanzi: 伪造证件是犯法的。
examples.pinyin: Wěizào zhèngjiàn shì fànfǎ de.
examples.english: Forging documents is against the law.

examples.hanzi: 警察发现这些钞票是伪造的。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá fāxiàn zhèxiē chāopiào shì wěizào de.
examples.english: The police discovered that these banknotes were counterfeit.

examples.hanzi: 主角在第二幕才出场。
examples.pinyin: Zhǔjué zài dì-èr mù cái chūchǎng.
examples.english: The lead character only comes on stage in the second act.

examples.hanzi: 他受伤了，今天不能出场比赛。
examples.pinyin: Tā shòushāng le, jīntiān bù néng chūchǎng bǐsài.
examples.english: He is injured and can't play in today's match.

examples.hanzi: 这套房子是以他妻子的名义买的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tào fángzi shì yǐ tā qīzi de míngyì mǎi de.
examples.english: This apartment was bought in his wife's name.

examples.hanzi: 他名义上是经理，其实没什么权力。
examples.pinyin: Tā míngyì shàng shì jīnglǐ, qíshí méi shénme quánlì.
examples.english: He is a manager in name only and actually has little power.

examples.hanzi: 半夜下起了大雨。
examples.pinyin: Bànyè xià qǐ le dàyǔ.
examples.english: It started pouring in the middle of the night.

examples.hanzi: 别半夜打电话给我，我要睡觉。
examples.pinyin: Bié bànyè dǎ diànhuà gěi wǒ, wǒ yào shuìjiào.
examples.english: Don't call me in the middle of the night; I need to sleep.

examples.hanzi: 拉斯维加斯有很多大赌场。
examples.pinyin: Lāsīwéijiāsī yǒu hěn duō dà dǔchǎng.
examples.english: Las Vegas has many big casinos.

examples.hanzi: 我朋友从来不去赌场。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ péngyou cónglái bú qù dǔchǎng.
examples.english: My friend never goes to casinos.

examples.hanzi: 他力气很大，一个人就能搬动沙发。
examples.pinyin: Tā lìqi hěn dà, yí gè rén jiù néng bāndòng shāfā.
examples.english: He is so strong that he can move the sofa by himself.

examples.hanzi: 跑完步我一点力气都没有了。
examples.pinyin: Pǎo wán bù wǒ yìdiǎn lìqi dōu méiyǒu le.
examples.english: After running, I have no strength left at all.
